facts.fact: Hespress reports that the House of Representatives bureau announced at a public sitting early in the week of 9 January 2025 that it had received a private member's bill on regulating the use of AI, 17 articles, tabled by six Mouvement Populaire deputies, with fines of 50,000 to 500,000 dirhams and prison of 6 months to 5 years for violations (event dated by the article's publication week).
